test_title: PYST 19: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 13 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the informationgiven in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the

statements.

Statements:

All bikes are roads.

Some roads are TVs.

Some TVs are cups.

Conclusions:

(I) All roads are bikes.

(II) All roads are TVs.
solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2932b21f204572c6fa9a8465e85ee2a445060edf44e60213c68bdb569af20cc2.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) All roads are bikes → False (As, All bikes are roads. so, All roads are bikes can be a possibility but not definte)

(II) All roads are TVs → False (As, Some roads are TVs. so, All roads are TVs can be a possibility but not definte)

Thus, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
